provenance: The example images are the approved TWO agent avatars, all AI-generated for TWO. The security-engineer, ux-designer, applied-cryptography-reviewer, release-manager, ledger-writer, reverse-engineer and paperclip-operator examples, and the eight council examples (board-secretary and the seat-* presets), were generated with this tool (gpt-image-2.5, 512 px); the other seven were made with an image-generation model before this tool existed. All are stored as approved, pixel for pixel. Each recipe is the preset and prompt this tool uses to generate a new variant in the same style, not a record of the exact original prompt. Image generation is non-deterministic.
